## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +3.86%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising and credit stress rising — HYG (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.50%) BELOW TREND / LQD (1W: -0.42% | 1M: -2.83%) BELOW TREND — but broad sector participation (Financials, Staples, Healthcare) keeps the regime mixed.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear INCREASING: VXX (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +3.86%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising. Credit stress RISING: Credit Spread (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +1.86%) → flat ABOVE TREND with HYG (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.50%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.42% | 1M: -2.83%) BELOW TREND. Regional tailwind: FXI (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +13.91%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tight. UUP (Dollar) (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +0.04%) CORRECTION → flat, TLT (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -4.91%) BELOW TREND and SPY/TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.80% | 1M: +1.52%) signal no clear easing of conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Financials leading: XLF (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +6.07%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary: XLY (1W: +2.82% | 1M: +2.34%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -7.60% | 1M: -10.16%) BELOW TREND. Style: Value/Cyclicals showing relative strength vs Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US soft: SPY (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -1.56%) BELOW TREND. China strong: FXI (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +13.91%) ABOVE TREND while broad EM EEM (1W: -6.03% | 1M: -9.43%) BELOW TREND — a bifurcated EM picture.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Cooling. ARKK (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND and IWM (1W: -1.78% | 1M: -3.48%) BELOW TREND show reduced risk-taking; IBIT (1W: -3.59% | 1M: +5.32%) CORRECTION signals selective crypto recovery but lower speculative breadth (Speculation Index BELOW TREND).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Mixed but constructive on the month: CPER (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +3.01%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -1.93% | 1M: +23.45%) CORRECTION show 1M strength with 1W pullback; GLD (1W: -2.12% | 1M: +0.68%) CORRECTION — metals cooling briefly.

8. Energy Trend?
Mixed. XLE (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +9.46%) CORRECTION with 1M gains and short-term pullback; UNG (1W: -6.32% | 1M: -13.12%) BELOW TREND — natural gas weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Financials/XLF (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +6.07%) ABOVE TREND and broad sector breadth (8/11) validate rotation into cyclicals. DIVERGENCE: Semis weakness (SOXX 1W: -16.29% | 1M: -24.31%) and tech drawdown (XLK 1W: -7.60% | 1M: -10.16%) are MAJOR negative divergences that suppress a full risk-on call.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to Financials and China: XLF (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +6.07%) ABOVE TREND, FXI (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +13.91%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to large-cap Tech and semis: XLK (1W: -7.60% | 1M: -10.16%) BELOW TREND, QQQ (1W: -6.18% | 1M: -8.61%) BELOW TREND, SOXX (1W: -16.29% | 1M: -24.31%) BELOW TREND; monitor VXX and credit (HYG/LQD).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLF (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +6.07%) ABOVE TREND if financial earnings/flows remain supportive; XLY (1W: +2.82% | 1M: +2.34%) ABOVE TREND on consumer strength. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -7.60% | 1M: -10.16%) BELOW TREND and SOXX (1W: -16.29% | 1M: -24.31%) BELOW TREND if semis weakness continues.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: BNO (1W: -1.93% | 1M: +23.45%) CORRECTION and CPER (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +3.01%) CORRECTION for reflationary risk; BEARISH: UNG (1W: -6.32% | 1M: -13.12%) BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -3.99% | 1M: -1.73%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 23–25 (elevated fear), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit stress threshold), XLK/XLF ratio ~2.0 (tech vs financial pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, but rising VXX and credit stress leave the market balanced between risk and caution. Financials and China showing strength while Tech and Semis are the main divergence to monitor.
